title: BenchmarkRun
description: One execution of a suite by a specific Worker+model under fully captured, reproducible conditions (BR-####). The environment block (provider, model, seed, harness version) is what makes a run replayable (ADR-0048; RFC-0025). Model choice is captured, never assumed — the same run definition can target any provider behind the Model Gateway (ARCH-07, ADR-0010).

worker.description: The Enterprise AI Worker implementation under test (sdk.workers.WorkerSpec).

worker_spec.description: Reference to the WorkerSpec (knowledge domains, tools, rubrics, policies) bound for this run.

cases.description: The frozen case set executed in this run.

repeats.description: Repeats per case executed in this run (each with a derived seed).

result_ref.description: The aggregate BenchmarkResult produced by this run.

prior_run.description: Prior run this one is compared against (e.g. earlier attempt for BENCH-09 Continuous Learning).
